13-1151.00:94.short: Run training sessions with role play, toolbox talks, group exercises, videos and short lectures on three sites.

reach.learn: Which feedback situations shift leaders struggle with, to build practice scenarios from them.

loop.stop: two rewrite passes per section; sections still failing go to manual translation
loop.why_not_simpler: Rewriting to a lower reading level and translating free text needs a language model; machine translation alone breaks fixed safety terms.

Publish in Studytube and SharePoint, keep versions

reach.learn: Which documents new starters and flex workers actually receive and when.

MHR's learning team has an agent draft content and check reading level, with a person reviewing.

Read open comments from evaluations and manager feedback

loop.output: Themes with counts and two example quotes each.
loop.check: Specialist spot-checks a sample; themes below five comments are not reported.
loop.stop: One pass per batch; comments that fit no theme go to an 'other' list for the person.

reach.learn: Add Studytube data to the HR model.

Evaluation fits Power BI plus a comment-clustering step at group level only.
Baselines should be set before launch.

Microsoft Learning agent suggests skill gaps and pathways, with HR still guiding role moves.
Training policy and personal data processing need works council consent.
